def design(feats):
    X = np.asarray(feats.x, float); y = np.asarray(feats.y, float); n, p = X.shape
    ids = list(feats.ids); types = list(feats.types)
    labs = sorted(set(feats.stratum))
    S = np.column_stack([np.ones(n)] + [np.array([s == l for s in feats.stratum], float) for l in labs[1:]])
    R = np.corrcoef(X, rowvar=False); R = np.nan_to_num(R); A = np.abs(R)
    def ll(cols):
        Z = np.column_stack([S] + cols) if cols else S
        b = np.zeros(Z.shape[1])
        for _ in range(30):
            eta = np.clip(Z @ b, -30, 30); m = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-eta)); w = m * (1 - m) + 1e-9
            H = Z.T @ (Z * w[:, None]) + 1e-6 * np.eye(Z.shape[1])
            step = np.linalg.solve(H, Z.T @ (y - m)); b += step
            if np.max(np.abs(step)) < 1e-7: break
        m = np.clip(1 / (1 + np.exp(-np.clip(Z @ b, -30, 30))), 1e-12, 1 - 1e-12)
        return float(np.sum(y * np.log(m) + (1 - y) * np.log(1 - m)))
    col = lambda j: X[:, j[0]] * X[:, j[1]] if isinstance(j, tuple) else X[:, j]
    deg = (A >= 0.6).sum(0) - 1
    hubs = [j for j in np.argsort(-deg) if types[j] == 'clinical' and deg[j] >= 3][:3]
    def nuis(sel, j):
        return [h for h in hubs if h != j and h not in sel and A[h, j] < 0.95]
    def gain(sel, j):
        base = [col(k) for k in sel] + [X[:, h] for h in nuis(sel, j)]
        return 2 * (ll(base + [X[:, j]]) - ll(base))
    sel = []
    gates = [0.3 / p, 0.2 / p, 0.1 / p]
    while len(sel) < MAX_DRIVERS:
        cand = [j for j in range(p) if all(A[j, k] < 0.6 for k in sel)]
        if not cand: break
        g = np.array([gain(sel, j) for j in cand]); bi = int(np.argmax(g))
        if stats.chi2.sf(g[bi], 1) > gates[min(len(sel), 2)]: break
        j = cand[bi]
        cl = [k for k in cand if A[j, k] >= 0.6]
        L = {k: ll([col(q) for q in sel] + [X[:, k]]) for k in cl}
        cl = [k for k in cl if max(L.values()) - L[k] < (3 if k in hubs else 2)]
        if any(k in hubs for k in cl): j = [k for k in cl if k in hubs][0]
        elif len(cl) > 1:
            j = max(cl, key=lambda k: np.sum(R[k, cl] ** 2))
        elif cl: j = cl[0]
        sel.append(j)
    changed = True
    while changed and sel:
        changed = False
        for j in list(sel):
            rest = [k for k in sel if k != j]
            if stats.chi2.sf(2 * (ll([col(k) for k in sel]) - ll([col(k) for k in rest])), 1) > 0.2 / p:
                sel.remove(j); changed = True; break
    pairs = [(a, b) for a in range(p) for b in range(a, p)]
    P = np.column_stack([X[:, a] * X[:, b] for a, b in pairs])
    m0 = np.full(n, y.mean()); sc = ((P.T @ (y - m0)) ** 2) / (np.var(P, 0) * n * y.mean() * (1 - y.mean()) + 1e-9)
    prods = []
    thr = 0.005 / len(pairs)
    for i in np.argsort(-sc)[:15]:
        a, b = pairs[i]
        base = [col(k) for k in sel] + [X[:, k] for k in {a, b} if k not in sel]
        g = 2 * (ll(base + [P[:, i]]) - ll(base))
        if stats.chi2.sf(g, 1) < thr and all(len({a, b} & set(q)) == 0 for q in prods):
            prods.append((a, b))
        if len(prods) >= 2: break
    for a, b in prods:
        for k in (a, b):
            if k not in sel and len(sel) < MAX_DRIVERS: sel.append(k)
    drivers = tuple(ids[j] for j in sel[:MAX_DRIVERS])
    cols = list(sel) + ([h for h in hubs if h not in sel and all(A[h, k] < 0.95 for k in sel)] if sel else [])
    return Design(drivers=drivers, columns=tuple(ids[j] for j in cols),
                  products=tuple((ids[a], ids[b]) for a, b in prods), loadings={})
